prompt: A clear editorial-style illustration of a service robot in a small grocery shop, shown as one integrated sensing-to-action system: a customer gives a spoken request, “Please get the red tea,” while sound waves travel toward the robot’s microphone; its camera view overlays identify several nearly identical tea boxes, including one partly hidden behind another item; arrows connect microphone and cameras to a visible internal AI decision map, then down to the robot’s motors and gripper as it carefully reaches for the correct box.
